title: Employment Prospects for Graduates of the Department of World Economy and Regional Studies

blocks.text: On April 24, 2025, the Department of World Economy and Regional Studies of the Kyrgyz-Chinese Faculty held the annual Round Table "Employment Prospects for Graduates of the Department of World Economy and Regional Studies" at Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev. In order to assist graduates in finding employment, increase students' motivation for self-development, and strengthen the system of interaction between the university and employers, a meeting of graduate students and stakeholders was held within the framework of this event.

During the Round Table, representatives of enterprises and organizations of the country emphasized the role of youth in the development of the country's economy, shared their work experience, talked about the requirements for personnel, gave recommendations on finding a job, the content of a resume, and advice on learning Chinese and other foreign languages.

The meeting participants were Rector M.M. Dyldaev, Vice-Rector for State Language and Extracurricular Work A.T. Satiev, Director of the Career, Practice and Marketing Center K.A. Toktobaev, Dean of the Kyrgyz-Chinese Faculty Botokanova G. T., 4th year students of the management program, international management profile, representatives of the Dasmiya company, Elet-Capital MFC,China-Kyrgyzstan Mining CompanyPublic organization "Kyrgyz El Birimdigi", Confucius Institute at BSU.
